page.overview:
Who is Jan Charouz?

Jan Charouz (born July 17, 1987 in Prague, Czech Republic) is a Czech racing driver, known for his test driver role at , and also drove for them in Free Practice at the 2011 Brazilian Grand Prix.

He was the second Czech driver at a Grand Prix weekend, after Tomáš Enge in .
